name: web-blurred-skeleton-dashboard-with-sidebar-cards-and-list-rows
title: Ghosted dashboard skeleton: a blurred sidebar, header bar, three stat cards and list rows in pale grey shapes
whatItIs: A white frame containing a very pale, blurred wireframe of an app: a left sidebar with items and a profile, a top bar with title and buttons, three stat cards and several list rows with rounded thumbnails and pills, all as soft grey blocks.
whatItMeans: Quiet and structural; a blurred skeleton shows layout without content.
techniques: Replace content with pale grey blocks.
Use as a loading or preview state.

vocabulary.definition: A placeholder showing layout while content loads.
A softened outline of an interface.
A placeholder rectangle for text or image.
A skeleton for a metric card.
